raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly defined the calculation of atomic mass. In standard chemistry contexts (and specifically for multiple-choice questions with integer options like 6, 7, 13, 19), "mass" refers to the mass number, which is the sum of protons and neutrons only. The mass of electrons is negligible (~1/1836 of a proton) and is never included in the mass number calculation. By explicitly adding the mass of the 6 electrons to the count of protons and neutrons, the Planner arrived at the incorrect answer of 19 (Option D) instead of the correct mass number of 13 (Option C).
